steps.content: The late autumn cold—a bone-deep chill unique to the season—seeps into you as you stagger through the garden. Icy rain needles down through the crumbling dome above.

Every step is a battle against your own failing body, the Mania's corruption a persistent venom in your veins, gnawing at the edges of your mind. Yet, a pull stronger than the fatigue draws you forward. You can feel it. You are getting closer to the heart of this place, closer to Hilda.
You only hope both you and Hilda can hold on. Just a little longer.

In the depths of the garden, the outline of a dilapidated lecture hall materializes. Moss creeps over the stone steps like a green shroud, and the heavy doors stand half-open, as if waiting for your arrival.
(Scene Change: Auditorium)
You push the door open and step inside. The air is thick and still, heavy with the scent of decaying wood and the ghost of old paper.

This is a university lecture hall, once a place of learning. Now, traces of Mania crawl like diseased ivy across the walls and floor. On the lone blackboard, faded cryptographic formulas and city-state slogans linger like forgotten memories.

And there, at the far end of the hall, an enormous spectral shadow is merged with the very architecture. It is so massive that it seems part of the wall, until you enter. Slowly, deliberately, it raises its head.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Oh... Look what the cat dragged in... Have you come to witness the lesson for my most disappointing pupil?

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Hilda. My brightest star... and my greatest fool!
The Corruptor that Manphist has become lets out a pained, mocking sound. It toys with Hilda's bowed head, its fingers moving over her like a merchant coldly tallying beads on an abacus.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: A position at the very heart of the Cryptography Department... something countless souls would kill for! The influence, the secrets, the power at your fingertips... and you cast it all aside like trash. For what? To run off to this festering swamp called DisCity to "prove" a point?
Foolish! Utterly, completely foolish!
Discordant whispers slither through the air, each one feeling like an ice-cold abacus bead clicking against another.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Was it the investigation that spooked you? Or was it the shame of your traitorous parents?
A harsh, grating sneer escapes it. Its fingers dig into Hilda's skull as it forces her head down, slamming her forehead against the stone table again and again.
She takes the abuse like a doll, her body limp, offering not even a flicker of resistance.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: An interrogation is a cost of doing business! A compromised identity is a manageable risk! Everyone in this game has skeletons. Every successful spy keeps a set of false ledgers! <i><color=#dg1f1f>Did you truly believe you could walk this path and keep your hands perfectly clean?!<i></color>
With a furious roar, it straightens its decaying body. Its rotting arms fly wide in a grotesque, exaggerated gesture of utter incomprehension.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>They just dangled a few doubts to shake your precious "faith," and you reacted like a scolded child, so desperate to prove you're still the teacher's pet.<i></color>

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>Ideals and loyalty are worthless currency! Yet you cling to them, willing to be someone's loyal hound, staking your entire being on a lost cause!<i></color>

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>You have no conception of the machine you serve! All that brilliant talent, wasted on solving the wrong equations!<i></color>

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>The greatest tragedy isn't weakness, but unshakable conviction in the wrong place! Your resolve is your folly! Your talent, your original sin!<i></color>
It spreads its arms wide, as if welcoming this hopeless conclusion.
With its stomps, the floor explodes. A foul, Mania-tainted sludge boils upward through the cracks, revealing a gaping maw that leads to the abyss itself.
From that void, countless ghostly shadows surge forth. They howl with a singular purpose, twisting and coiling around Hilda's body.
Admit it. This path was never for you. Your very existence is an error. Your failure was preordained. You deserve to be consumed... to settle the debt for your misguided life!
The world gives way. The ground shatters, and the two of you teeter on the edge of the abyss—

options: This is the price she must pay.
